text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is an Olympic games.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
Tokyo(x) ::: x is Tokyo.
Question: ::: The question about the world championships being a sporting event.

Premises:
The Olympic games is a sporting event ::: OlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x).
The last Olympic games was in Tokyo ::: LastOlympicGames(x) ∧ Location(x, Tokyo).
The United States won the most medals in Tokyo ::: WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, Tokyo).

Conclusion:
∃x (SportingEvent(x)) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
